name: native-select
useFor: Use when the platform's own picker is better: on phones, for long lists such as countries or states, or in forms that must work without script. Otherwise use Select. Use NativeSelectOptGroup to group options.
constraints: A field edge instead of the Shadow/S ring
A native select styled differently from Select on the same form
source: Figma 427:2715: the Any State and Shared selects in Create Agent Identity
title: Native Select
description: The browser's own select dressed as the console's: a white 40px field with the Shadow/S ring and an ink caret.
